items.title: Mike Tomlin reveals the Minecraft city he built for 12 years
items.summary: Former Steelers coach Mike Tomlin premiered a tour of the Minecraft city he had secretly built since 2014, and his X announcement passed 20 million views. The internet couldn't get over a Super Bowl-winning coach obsessing over rooftop penthouses and 'appropriate amenities'. The jokes flowed: Le'Veon Bell posted 'we were tryna win super bowls and coach T was on minecraft building cities', his son Mayce said his PlayStation used to vanish, and meme accounts tied the build to the Steelers' playoff struggles.
items.author: @CoachTomlin

items.title: Tomlin's 'EP 1: Rooftops, Penthouses, and Urban Living' blows up
items.summary: The nearly 20-minute first episode of Tomlin's Minecraft series premiered at 8 p.m. ET on Sept. 30 and topped 334,000 views in four hours, then kept climbing toward a million overnight. Viewers loved his apologies for his 'lack of stick control' and the 'Trump Tower' penthouse with its disclaimer caption. The official NFL and Minecraft accounts both showed up in the comments.
items.author: @miket757
